conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed graph/hypergraph construction, join legality, tree spaces, subset DP, graph-aware enumeration, properties, physical implementations, pruning, bounded/learned search, uncertainty, diagnosis, and evaluation.

pedagogical_review.notes: The chapter derives enumeration from semantics and properties, executes an exhaustive greedy counterexample, covers fourteen misconceptions and ten distinct examples, and advances five exercises to an elite verification/rollout design with complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary/official-source, mathematical, executable-snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external database theorist, optimizer maintainer, SQL semantics reviewer, distributed-systems operator, ML reviewer, security/privacy reviewer, platform owner, or educator review is claimed. The chapter and finite model prove neither completeness for arbitrary SQL, correctness of a production legality engine, tractability of large property spaces, cardinality/cost accuracy, learned generalization, global plan optimality, representative performance, privacy, fairness, certification, nor deployment fitness.
